messages.text: Searched the catalog · Harlo B30 Magic Miner 40T H15 Dual

At 16¢ a kWh the B30 is the pick on the Bitcoin side — 30 TH/s at ~400W, $899, ships Nov 30. The H15 Dual you're looking at hasn't dropped yet, so it isn't buyable today.

If you want the Dogecoin half too, the Hammer DC02 kit is $239.99 and in stock now.

Is this your first miner, or adding to something you already run?

Then the B30 is the one I'd start you on. Quiet enough for a home office at ~50 dB, plugs into a normal outlet, and it draws for a full block every ten minutes while it stacks small payouts to your own wallet. You learn the whole thing — pools, wallets, firmware — on a machine you can hear running.

Where would it sit?

Ontario's easy on the shipping and customs side — no import VAT or duty into Canada, sales tax added at checkout, and the unit comes with the right plug for your address.

At 16¢ the B30's ~400W is the sweet spot: it's the quieter, lower-draw pick over the bigger Magic Miner. $899, ships Nov 30.

Want me to build the cart?

Every price on the site is USD, so the B30 is $899 USD. Your card or PayPal does the conversion at their rate on the day — we don't bill in CAD, so I won't quote you a CAD figure that'd be wrong by the time you check out.

Shipping and Canadian sales tax show up in checkout totals before you pay. Shall I build it?

Done — one Harlo B30, $899 USD, ships Nov 30, plug matched to your Ontario address.
